item.title: Verification Before Scale: How the Claude Code Team Tests Agent Work and Audits Its Checks
item.description: How the Claude Code team gets agents to prove their work with evidence: which tests to invest in first (end-to-end, property, differential), a commit gate that starts in observe mode, review rules a change cannot edit, and a process for turning missed bugs into rules.
